name: pdf-ocr-docs
description: Documentation site for pdf-ocr. The application itself is Python; this package only builds the docs.
overridesReason: vitepress 1.6.x pins vite ^5.4.14, which resolves to a version with four published advisories (one high). All four are dev-server issues and this project only ever runs `vitepress build`, but leaving them open would mask the next real one. vitepress 2.x uses a patched vite but is still alpha. Forcing vite 6 / esbuild 0.25 keeps the build working and npm audit clean; drop these overrides once vitepress ships a stable release on vite 6+.
